name: Galactic Gadgeteer: The Lost Worlds
tagline: Explore strange worlds. Discover incredible gadgets. Save the galaxy.
description: An original hand-illustrated 2D sci-fi platformer starring Pip, a young gadgeteer, and BOLT, a hovering robot with opinions. The first playable expedition, The Fallen Beacon, is a complete Starlight Meadows level built around responsive movement: a meadow gate, a jetpack chasm, a magnetic crate puzzle, spring-boot gardens and a phase-thin wall all lead to a lost Starlight Engine fragment. Keyboard, mouse, standard-mapped controller and multitouch controls feed the same input layer; the game pauses cleanly when a controller disconnects or the browser loses focus, and landscape is enforced on phones. Original art, animation and music are generated in-engine, with no external asset pack.
highlights: A complete playable Starlight Meadows expedition, from the meadow gate to the Starlight fragment
All five gadgets: plasma blaster, jetpack, spring boots, magnet glove and phase dash
Keyboard and mouse, standard-mapped controllers, and true multitouch virtual controls
Landscape-only mobile presentation with a polished rotate overlay
Original procedural character art, parallax scenery, particles and synthesized music
Star Shards, hidden data capsules and a breakable secret wall
howToPlay: Standard controls: move with the arrow keys or A/D, jump with Space, fire with J, and use your gadget with K.
Choose a gadget with 1–5; K uses it. On touch, use the left thumb pad and the action buttons.
Collect the jetpack, magnet glove, spring boots and phase dash to solve the meadow's traversal puzzles.
Touching any enemy pops it, whether you run into it, brush it in mid-air or land on it.
Reach the Starlight Engine fragment at the end of the meadow. Break the cracked wall for a hidden data capsule.
On a phone, rotate to landscape. The game pauses safely if the device turns portrait.
